notes.title: V1.3.8 version update
notes.content:
🎉 New Features!

Warriors can now turn off the display of skill descriptions and passive icons during battles. ‧ During battle, warriors can find an icon in the bottom left corner to manage this setting.

Warriors can now change their in-game name.

🔧 Fixes & Improvements

Warriors should now be able to safely log in, bind, and unbind accounts.

notes.title: v1.3.0 release update
notes.content:
Update Highlights:

🎉 New Features!
·Import function added 
·Limited-time Arena Event.
·SCAR Store implemented, adjusting based on exchange rate fluctuations.


🌟 New character
·COOLBEAUTY MARILYN

🔧 Fixes and Improvements
·After losing a battle, players were not matched with lower-ranked players.
·Notifications no longer appear after the game is removed.
·Extensive visual optimizations

notes.title: v1.2.0 release update
notes.content:
Update Highlights:

🎉 New Features!
·Rarity Skill Recast System is now live! Unlock new abilities and power up your characters.
·New Card UI is released for a better gaming experience.

🌟 New Skills
·Added Rarity Skills to boost character power.

🔧 Fixes and Improvements
·Resolved some bugs and optimized mobile touch range.
·Exchange Shop: Crystals can now be traded for more resources.
·Olaf's Invincibility is now Shield Absorption, scaling with level.

notes.title: V1.1.0 version update
notes.content:
1. Heroes now can learn random skills!
2. We've added a variety of new stores with a wider selection of items.
3. Discord Link: Join our Discord server and meet new friends!
4. Mail System: Check your inbox for unclaimed rewards.
5. Corey Pioneer Pack: A new bundle featuring Corey.
6. Optimized certain features and UI/UX experience.
7. Fixed several bugs.

notes.title: v1.0.1 version update
notes.content:
1. Fixed an issue where a shimmering white light would appear on star islands on some devices.
2. Fixed an issue where users were unable to log in or bind their X accounts(Apple / Steam).
3. Fixed an occasional display error that occurred when crafting combat tiles.
4. Increased rewards for Alien Invasion, allowing players to earn additional Jade.
5. Optimized the PvP matchmaking system to reduce the frequency of repeated matches.
